AutoProvisioningGroup.description_en: The details of the auto-provisioning group
AutoProvisioningGroup.description_zh: 弹性供应组的详细信息

items.description_en: The details of the auto-provisioning group
items.description_zh: 弹性供应组的详细信息

AutoProvisioningGroupId.description_en: The ID of the auto provisioning group

AutoProvisioningGroupName.description_en: The name of the auto provisioning group

AutoProvisioningGroupType.description_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:

request: one-time. The auto provisioning group delivers instance clusters only at startup and does not retry after scheduling failures.

maintain: continuous provisioning. The auto provisioning group attempts to deliver instance clusters at startup and monitors real-time capacity. If the target capacity is not met, the group continues to create ECS instances
AutoProvisioningGroupType.description_zh:
交付类型。可能值：

request：一次性。供应组仅在启动时交付实例集群，调度失败后不再重试。

maintain：持续供应。供应组在启动时尝试交付实例集群，并监控实时容量，未达到目标容量则尝试继续创建ECS实例

TimeoutMinutes.title_zh: 供应组尝试扩容出目标容量的超时时间。单位：分钟。

PayAsYouGoCapacity.title_zh: 弹性供应组内当前按量实例容量。

PrePaidCapacity.title_zh: 弹性供应组内当前包年包月实例容量。

SpotCapacity.title_zh: 弹性供应组内当前抢占式实例容量。

TotalCapacity.title_zh: 弹性供应组内当前实例总容量。

CapacitySpecification.title_zh: 弹性供应组当前容量分布。

ExcessCapacityTerminationPolicy.description_en:
Specifies whether to release scaled-in instances when the real-time capacity of the auto provisioning group exceeds the target capacity and a scale-in event is triggered. Valid values:

termination: releases scaled-in instances.
no-termination: only removes scaled-in instances from the auto provisioning group
ExcessCapacityTerminationPolicy.description_zh:
弹性供应组实时容量超过目标容量并触发缩容时，是否释放缩容的实例。可能值：

termination：释放缩容的实例。
no-termination：只将缩容的实例移出弹性供应组

LaunchTemplateConfig.description_en: The details of the extended launch template
LaunchTemplateConfig.description_zh: 扩展启动模板的详细信息

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type specified in the extended launch template
InstanceType.description_zh: 扩展启动模板对应的实例规格

MaxPrice.description_en: The maximum price of the instance type specified in the extended launch template
MaxPrice.description_zh: 扩展启动模板对应实例规格的价格上限

Priority.description_en: The priority of the instance type specified in the extended launch template. A value of 0 indicates the highest priority
Priority.description_zh: 扩展启动模板对应的实例规格的优先级，取值为0时最高

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch specified in the extended launch template
VSwitchId.description_zh: 扩展启动模板对应的虚拟交换机的ID

WeightedCapacity.description_en: The weight of the instance type specified in the extended launch template
WeightedCapacity.description_zh: 扩展启动模板对应的实例规格的权重

LaunchTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the associated instance launch template
LaunchTemplateId.description_zh: 关联的实例启动模板的ID

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en: The version of the associated instance launch template
LaunchTemplateVersion.description_zh: 关联的实例启动模板的版本

MaxSpotPrice.description_en:
The maximum price of spot instances.

When both MaxSpotPrice and LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice are specified, the lower value takes precedence.

LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice is set when you create the auto provisioning group and cannot be modified
MaxSpotPrice.description_zh:
抢占式实例的最高价格。

同时设置了MaxSpotPrice和LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice时，以最低值为准。

LaunchTemplateConfig.N.MaxPrice在创建弹性供应组时设置，且不可修改

PayAsYouGoOptions.description_zh: 按量付费实例相关的策略

AllocationStrategy.description_en:
The policy for creating pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

lowest-price: cost optimization policy. The instance type with the lowest price is selected.

prioritized: priority-based policy. Instances are created based on the priority specified by LaunchTemplateConfig.N.Priority.

LaunchTemplateConfig.N.Priority is specified when you create an auto provisioning group and cannot be modified
AllocationStrategy.description_zh:
创建按量付费实例的策略。可能值：

lowest-price：成本优化策略。选择价格最低的实例规格。

prioritized：优先级策略。按照LaunchTemplateConfig.N.Priority设定的优先级创建实例。

LaunchTemplateConfig.N.Priority在创建弹性供应组时设置，且不可修改

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the auto-provisioning group belongs
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 弹性供应组所属的资源组ID

SpotOptions.description_en: The policies related to spot instances
SpotOptions.description_zh: 抢占式实例相关的策略

AllocationStrategy.description_en:
The policy for creating spot instances. Valid values:

lowest-price: cost optimization policy. Spot instance type with the lowest price.

diversified: balanced zone distribution policy. Spot instance in the zones specified in the extended launch template and distributes them evenly across zones
AllocationStrategy.description_zh:
创建抢占式实例的策略。可能值：

lowest-price：成本优化策略。选择价格最低的实例规格。

diversified：均衡可用区分布策略。在扩展启动模板指定的可用区内创建实例，均匀分布到各可用区

InstanceInterruptionBehavior.description_en:
The action to perform after excess spot instances are stopped. Valid values:

stop: Keeps the instances in the stopped state.
terminate: Releases the instances
InstanceInterruptionBehavior.description_zh:
停止了超额的抢占式实例后的下一步动作。可能值：

stop：保持停止状态。
terminate：释放

InstancePoolsToUseCount.description_en:
The number of instance types with the lowest prices that the auto provisioning group uses to create instances.

This parameter is set when you create the auto provisioning group and cannot be modified
InstancePoolsToUseCount.description_zh:
弹性供应组选择价格最低的实例规格创建实例的数量。

该参数在创建弹性供应组时被设置，且不可修改

State.description_en:
The overall scheduling status of the auto provisioning group. Valid values:

fulfilled: The scheduling task is completed.
pending-fulfillment: Instances are being created.
pending-termination: Instances are being removed.
error: An error occurred during scheduling and the instance cluster failed to be delivered
State.description_zh:
弹性供应组整体调度的执行状态。可能值：

fulfilled：已成功完成调度任务。
pending-fulfillment：创建实例中。
pending-termination：移除实例中。
error：调度时发生异常，未能交付实例集群

Status.description_en:
The status of the auto provisioning group. Valid values:

submitted: The auto provisioning group is created but has not started to execute scheduling tasks.
active: The auto provisioning group has started to execute scheduling tasks.
deleted: The auto provisioning group is deleted.
delete-running: The auto provisioning group is being deleted.
modifying: The auto provisioning group is being modified
Status.description_zh:
弹性供应组的状态。可能值：

submitted：完成创建，但弹性供应组尚未开始执行调度任务。
active：弹性供应组已开始执行调度任务。
deleted：弹性供应组已删除。
delete-running：弹性供应组删除中。
modifying：弹性供应组修改中

items.title_zh:
弹性供应组暂停的流程。
可能值：
1. ScaleIn：缩容流程。
2. ScaleOut：扩容流程。

SuspendedProcess.title_zh:
弹性供应组暂停的流程。
可能值：
1. ScaleIn：缩容流程。
2. ScaleOut：扩容流程。

Tag.description_en: The tags attached to the auto-provisioning group
Tag.description_zh: 弹性供应组绑定的标签

items.description_en: The tags attached to the auto-provisioning group
items.description_zh: 弹性供应组绑定的标签

TagKey.description_en:
The tag key of the auto-provisioning group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://
TagKey.description_zh:
弹性供应组的标签键。

N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://

TagValue.description_en:
The tag value of the auto-provisioning group.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://
TagValue.description_zh:
弹性供应组的标签值。

N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能包含http://或者https://

TargetCapacitySpecification.description_en: The target capacity settings of the auto provisioning group
TargetCapacitySpecification.description_zh: 弹性供应组的目标容量设置

DefaultTargetCapacityType.description_en:
The billing method of the capacity difference when the sum of PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity and SpotTargetCapacity is less than TotalTargetCapacity. Valid values:

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go instance
Spot: spot instance
DefaultTargetCapacityType.description_zh:
`PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity`和`SpotTargetCapacity`之和小于`TotalTargetCapacity`时，指定的差额容量的计费方式。可能值：

PayAsYouGo：按量付费实例
Spot：抢占式实例

PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity.description_en: The target capacity of pay-as-you-go instances
PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity.description_zh: 按量付费实例的目标容量

SpotTargetCapacity.description_en: The target capacity of spot instances
SpotTargetCapacity.description_zh: 抢占式实例的目标容量

TotalTargetCapacity.description_en:
Target total capacity of the auto provisioning group, which consists of the following three parts:

PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity
SpotTargetCapacity
Difference between TotalTargetCapacity and the sum of PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity and SpotTargetCapacity
TotalTargetCapacity.description_zh:
弹性供应组的目标总容量，由以下三个部分组成：

PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity
SpotTargetCapacity
PayAsYouGoTargetCapacity和SpotTargetCapacity之外的差额容量

TerminateInstances.description_en:
Specifies whether to release instances in the auto provisioning group when the group is deleted. Valid values:

true: releases instances in the group.
false: retains instances in the group
TerminateInstances.description_zh:
删除弹性供应组时，是否释放组内实例。可能值：

true：释放组内实例。
false：保留组内实例

TerminateInstancesWithExpiration.description_en:
Specifies whether to release instances in the auto provisioning group when the group expires. Valid values:

true: Instances in the group are released.
false: Instances are removed from the group
TerminateInstancesWithExpiration.description_zh:
弹性供应组到期时，是否释放组内实例。可能值：

true：释放组内实例。
false：只将组内实例移出弹性供应组

ValidFrom.description_en: The start time of the auto provisioning group. The value of this parameter and the value of `ValidUntil` determine the effective period of the auto provisioning group
ValidFrom.description_zh: 弹性供应组的启动时间，和`ValidUntil`结合确定有效时段

ValidUntil.description_en: The expiration time of the auto provisioning group. This parameter and `ValidFrom` determine the validity period
ValidUntil.description_zh: 弹性供应组的到期时间，和`ValidFrom`结合确定有效时段

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of queried auto-provisioning groups
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的弹性供应组的个数
